nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Plastic waste reduction|Plastic packaging reduction_qna_000
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: Which two activities related to plastics were the least performed by the respondents according to the survey?
nodes.answer: The two least performed activities were collecting plastic litter from the environment and using bioplastic products.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Plastic waste reduction|Plastic packaging reduction_qna_001
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What are the main drivers of consumers' plastic packaging waste avoidance and recycling according to the systematic literature review by Foot Jacobsen et al.?
nodes.answer: The main drivers identified in the systematic literature review include environmental concern, convenience, social influence, and economic incentives.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Plastic waste reduction|Plastic packaging reduction_qna_002
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What are some barriers to consumers' plastic packaging waste avoidance and recycling according to Foot Jacobsen et al.?
nodes.answer: Some barriers highlighted in the review are a lack of awareness, inconvenience, lack of access to recycling facilities, and perceived high costs associated with recycling.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Plastic waste reduction|Plastic packaging reduction_qna_003
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What are some structural factors that influence individual plastic packaging consumption based on the focus group discussions with German consumers?
nodes.answer: The structural factors that influence individual plastic packaging consumption include availability of plastic packaging options in the market, pricing, marketing strategies, and lack of convenient alternatives.
